newsitem.title: USA: Commerce Group EPS to be hurt by rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Group EPS to be hurt by rate cut.

text.p: Commerce Group Inc said Friday that lower rates in automobile insurance in the state of Massachusetts would hurt its earnings-per-share estimates from 1997 to 1999.
Commerce said the smaller rates will cut its estimates by $0.28 a share in 1997, $0.41 in 1998 and $0.23 in 1999.
It said the Massachusetts Commissioner of Insurance lowered rates in 1996 to correct an industry error that had affected rate decisions the previous year.
The commission also lowered 1997 and 1998 rates after the reconciliation of Safe Driver Insurance Plan registered a surplus last year, it said.

Commerce said the Automobile Insurers Bureau of Massachusetts had filed an appeal with the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court challenging the commissioner's decision to decrease future rates for the industry error.
The bureau is not challenging the Safe Driver reconciliation, it added.
